phases.title: Implement filterProducts logic in src/utils/productFilters.ts
phases.notes: Implemented search (case-insensitive, trimmed), category, inStockOnly filters, and price-asc/price-desc/rating-desc sorting. Filtering/sorting tests remain red until phases 2 and 3 wire up the UI handlers.

phases.title: Wire up FilterPanel event handlers (search, category, inStockOnly, clear)

phases.title: Wire up SortSelect onChange handler
phases.notes: Renamed _onChange back to onChange, wired select's onChange to call onChange(e.target.value as FilterState['sortBy']). All 17 tests pass and build succeeds.
